cases.title: Directive definition and usages on fields

oracle.divergence_note: The importer does not recognise a schema definition that carries a directive, so the explicit root (query=RootQuery) and its operation are missing; the reference library reads both.

cases.title: Control: the same schema definition without the directive
Opening brace on the next line drops fields and operations

oracle.divergence_note: The line oriented importer drops the fields and operations of a declaration whose opening brace is on a later line; the reference library reads them.

cases.title: A field referencing an undefined type is accepted

cases.title: A duplicate type definition is accepted

cases.title: An interface named Query is treated as the query root

oracle.divergence_note: Both library versions build the schema but report a validation error (Query root type must be Object type, it cannot be Query.); the importer accepts an interface as the query root.
